snippet.title: Chaotic: Shadow Warriors - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2009)
snippet.description:
Chaotic: Shadow Warriors - Xbox 360 / Ps3 Gameplay (2009)

Subscribe: http://goo.gl/01dGfm


Chaotic: Shadow Warriors is a 2009 action video game based on the TV series. It was released in North America on November 10, 2009 on the PlayStation 3, Wii, Xbox 360 and Nintendo DS.The game is currently in a Hiatus, and players are willing to know who actually Owns the legal rights. If the owner talk with them, they'll rebuild the website and start everything for free. All they want is to play like it was in 2007.


Recorded by Elgato Game Capture HD
